instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Mental health tech company offering an app-based cognitive behavioral therapy program with human therapist chat support. 18,000 active users. Clinical evidence from a published RCT showing 40% reduction in PHQ-9 scores. Expanding into corporate wellness programs and evaluating AI-supported therapist productivity tools. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 7 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 5 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Operationalizing Care Pathways via Process Mapping
opportunities.rationale: To meet the 500 basis point EBITDA margin goal, Vault must move beyond product features and optimize how care is delivered. Deep process mapping of therapy sessions (human interaction vs. digital support) will identify high-cost manual touchpoints and bottlenecks. This incremental approach builds efficiency by standardizing workflows across departments.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional 'Process Excellence' task force with senior sponsor backing (C-I-O level).
Map the current state of the top 3 most costly patient journeys, identifying time sinks and redundant approvals.
Conduct internal simulation workshops to model optimized post-mapping workflows.
resources_needed: Dedicated FTE from Finance/Ops for 6 months
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average cost per active user segment by 10% within 12 months.
milestones: Proposed optimized workflow documented and validated (Month 4).
Pilot deployment of new pathway reducing cycle time metrics (Month 8).

opportunities.title: Implementing AI-Driven Triage and Productivity Suite
opportunities.rationale: The shift towards evaluating AI tools requires a bold leap to maintain competitive advantage. Integrating AI not just for productivity, but for clinical triage support (risk scoring, initial care recommendations) offers the highest potential ROI by replacing manual decision points. This must be highly regulated from day one.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated Regulatory/Compliance sandbox to assess AI deployment risk and necessary certifications.
Define the minimal viable product (MVP) scope: AI-assisted documentation or initial intake screening, focusing on measurable time savings.
Engage legal and clinical subject matter experts immediately to build ethical guardrails.
execution_plan.success_metric: Measurable reduction in therapist administrative time spent per patient encounter by 20%.
milestones: AI MVP trained and tested on internal, anonymized data sets (Month 7).
Successful pilot deployment with controlled user group (Month 12).

next_steps.action: Mandate a bi-weekly 'Innovation ROI Sprint' meeting involving department heads and the C-I-O to ensure all proposed initiatives are framed with clear, quantifiable ROI timelines (<12 months).
Draft a formal organizational charter for the 'Process Excellence' task force, securing executive sponsorship to overcome divisional inertia and competing priorities.
Conduct a formal audit of current technical debt versus the immediate efficiency gains achieved by process optimization to prioritize resource allocation.

key_weaknesses: Organizational inertia and misalignment across decentralized business units, leading to siloed efficiency efforts.
Lack of a standardized governance process for validating innovation learning (evidenced by the self-service portal failure).
High accumulation of technical debt which could impede future radical technological scaling initiatives.

improvements: Successful product launch cycle demonstrated capability and improved user trust, leading to a 5 point NPS increase.
The company has quantified its financial objective (500 bps EBITDA margin improvement) providing clear focus for resource deployment.
persistent_gaps: Process standardization remains informal despite complex governance structure.
Inability to translate technical success (new features) into measurable process or unit cost efficiency gains.
Technical debt is noted as a growing risk that requires dedicated attention.
achieved_milestones: Successful delivery of 7 new product features; high user satisfaction confirmed by NPS metric.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The organization has matured from product focus to explicit efficiency and cost control mandates (EBITDA goal). While resources are better defined (€5M fund), the core challenge remains moving from isolated project success to systemic process optimization.
